chapterInfo.content:
7
Tetesɛm ho nkyerɛkyerɛ
(Mateo 15.1-20)
1Na Farisifoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no mu binom a wɔfiri Yerusalem ba bɛhyiaa ne nkyɛn. 2#Luka 11.38 Na wɔhunuu n’asuafoɔ bi sɛ wɔde nsa a ɛho nteɛ, ɛne sɛ, nsa a wɔanhohorɔ, redidi. 3(Na Farisifoɔ ne Yudafoɔ nyinaa, sɛ wɔanhohoro wɔn nsa yie a, wɔnnidi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkura mpanimfoɔ atetesɛm mu; 4na sɛ wɔfiri dwa ase ba, na wɔanhohoro wɔn ho a, wɔnnidi; na nnoɔma pii keka ho a wɔgyee sɛ wɔbɛkuta mu, nkuruwa ne mpɔɔdɔ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛsɛn ne nnamu ho hohorɔ.) 5Ɛnna Farisifoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no bisaa no sɛ: Adɛn nti na w’asuafoɔ no nni mpanimfoɔ atetesɛm soɔ, na wɔde nsa fi didie yi? 6#Yes 29.13 Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Ɛdi sɛ Yesaia hyɛɛ mo nyaatwomfoɔ ho nkɔm, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɔman yi de wɔn ano na ɛdi me ni,
na wɔn akoma deɛ atwe afiri me ho kɔ akyirikyiri.
7 Na wɔsɔre me kwa,
na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a nnipa ahyehyɛ.
8 Na moagya Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ, kura nnipa atetesɛm mu.
9Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mofa nyansa kwan so po Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mobɛdi mo atetesɛm soɔ! 10#Eks 20.12; 21.17 Na Mose kaa sɛ: Di w’agya ne wo na ni; ɛne: Deɛ ɔka agya anaa ɛna ho asɛmmɔne no, owuo na ma no nwuo! 11Na mo deɛ, mose: Sɛ onipa bi se n’agya anaa ne na sɛ: Adeɛ a anka wode bɛnya me ho mfasoɔ no yɛ Korban (Ɛne sɛ, wɔde ma Onyankopɔn)#7.11 Anaasɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ. a, 12na momma no nyɛ biribiara mma n’agya anaa ne na bio, 13na mode mo atetesɛm a mokyerɛ no sɛe Nyankopɔn asɛm no, na nnoɔma a ɛte sɛ yeinom pii na moyɛ. 14Na ɔfrɛɛ nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn see wɔn sɛ: Mo nyinaa montie, na monte aseɛ! 15#Aso 10.14-15 Biribiara nni onipa ho a ɛkɔ ne mu a ɛbɛtumi agu ne ho fi. 16(Sɛ obi wɔ aso a ɔde bɛtie a, ɔntie!) 17Na ɔfirii nkurɔfokuo no nkyɛn baa fie no, n’asuafoɔ no bisaa no bɛ no ase. 18Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo nso monni nteaseɛ sei? Monhunu sɛ adeɛ biara a ɛfiri onipa ho, na ɛkɔ ne mu no ntumi ngu ne ho fi anaa? 19Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnkɔ n’akomam, na mmom ɛkɔ ɔyafunu mu, na mmom ɔyi gu yaane mu. (Ɔkaa yei de tee aduane nyinaa ho). 20Na ɔkaa sɛ: Deɛ ɛfiri onipa mu ba no, ɛno na ɛgu onipa ho fi. 21Na nnipa mu, wɔn akoma mu, na adwemmɔne firi ba: Adwamansɛm, akorɔnsɛm, awudisɛm, 22ayerefasɛm, aniberebereɛ, amumuyɛ, nsisie, ahohwie, anibɔne, abususɛm, ahantan ne nkwaseasɛm. 23Nnebɔne yi nyinaa firi onipa mu na ɛba, na ɛgu onipa ho fi.
Siro-Foinikeni baa bi gyidie
(Mateo 15.21-28)
24Na ɔsɔre firii hɔ kɔɔ Tiro ne Sidon fam. Na ɔkɔɔ efie bi mu, na wampɛ sɛ obiara teɛ; nso wantumi anhunta. 25Na amonom hɔ ara ɔbaa bi a ne babaa kumaa bi wɔ honhom fi tee ne nka no, ɔba bɛhwee ne nan ase; 26nso na ɔbaa no yɛ Helani, na n’awoɔ mu ɔyɛ Siro-Foinikeni; na ɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔntu honhommɔne no mfiri ne babaa no mu. 27Na Yesu see no sɛ: Ma mma mmee ansa; na ɛnyɛ fɛ sɛ wɔfa mma aduane to ma nkraman. 28Na ɔbaa no bua see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛwom saa deɛ; nanso nkraman a wɔwɔ ɛpono ase no nso di mmɔfra no mporoporowa no bi! 29Na Yesu see no sɛ: Asɛm yi nti, kɔ! Honhommɔne no afiri wo babaa no mu. 30Na ɔkɔɔ ne fie no, ɔkɔhunuu sɛ honhommɔne no afiri kɔ, na ne babaa no da mpa so.
Ɔdodoworofoɔ bi ayaresa
31 # Mat 15.29-31 Na ɔfiri Tiro ahyeɛ so nam Sidon baa Galilea po ho faa Dekapoli ahyeɛ so. 32#Mat 5.23 Na wɔde ɔsotifoɔ a ɔworo dodoɔ brɛɛ no, na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nto ne so. 33#Mar 8.23 Na Yesu faa no firii nkurɔfokuo no mu kɔɔ nkyɛn de ne nsateaa hyehyɛɛ n’asom, na ɔtee ntasuo de kaa ne tɛkyerɛma, 34#Mar 6.41; Yoh 11.41 na ɔhwɛɛ soro guu ahome, na ɔsee no sɛ: Hefata! ɛne sɛ: Bue! 35Na n’aso buee, na ne tɛkyerɛma homa no sanee ntɛm ara, na ɔtumi kasaa yie. 36#Mar 1.43-45 Na ɔbaraa wɔn sɛ wɔnnka nkyerɛ obiara; nanso ɔrekɔ so bara wɔn no, na wɔrekɔ so pae mu ka. 37Na ɛyɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri boroo so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Wayɛ nnoɔma nyinaa yie, ɔma asotifoɔ te asɛm, na ɔma emum kasa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Farisifoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no mu binom a wɔfiri Yerusalem ba bɛhyiaa ne nkyɛn. Na wɔhunuu n’asuafoɔ bi sɛ wɔde nsa a ɛho nteɛ, ɛne sɛ, nsa a wɔanhohorɔ, redidi. (Na Farisifoɔ ne Yudafoɔ nyinaa, sɛ wɔanhohoro wɔn nsa yie a, wɔnnidi, ɛfiri sɛ wɔkura mpanimfoɔ atetesɛm mu; na sɛ wɔfiri dwa ase ba, na wɔanhohoro wɔn ho a, wɔnnidi; na nnoɔma pii keka ho a wɔgyee sɛ wɔbɛkuta mu, nkuruwa ne mpɔɔdɔ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛsɛn ne nnamu ho hohorɔ.) Ɛnna Farisifoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no bisaa no sɛ: Adɛn nti na w’asuafoɔ no nni mpanimfoɔ atetesɛm soɔ, na wɔde nsa fi didie yi? Na ɔbua see wɔn sɛ: Ɛdi sɛ Yesaia hyɛɛ mo nyaatwomfoɔ ho nkɔm, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Ɔman yi de wɔn ano na ɛdi me ni,
na wɔn akoma deɛ atwe afiri me ho kɔ akyirikyiri.
Na wɔsɔre me kwa,
na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nsɛm a nnipa ahyehyɛ.
Na moagya Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ, kura nnipa atetesɛm mu.
Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mofa nyansa kwan so po Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mobɛdi mo atetesɛm soɔ! Na Mose kaa sɛ: Di w’agya ne wo na ni; ɛne: Deɛ ɔka agya anaa ɛna ho asɛmmɔne no, owuo na ma no nwuo! Na mo deɛ, mose: Sɛ onipa bi se n’agya anaa ne na sɛ: Adeɛ a anka wode bɛnya me ho mfasoɔ no yɛ Korban (Ɛne sɛ, wɔde ma Onyankopɔn) a, na momma no nyɛ biribiara mma n’agya anaa ne na bio, na mode mo atetesɛm a mokyerɛ no sɛe Nyankopɔn asɛm no, na nnoɔma a ɛte sɛ yeinom pii na moyɛ. Na ɔfrɛɛ nkurɔfokuo no nyinaa baa ne nkyɛn see wɔn sɛ: Mo nyinaa montie, na monte aseɛ! Biribiara nni onipa ho a ɛkɔ ne mu a ɛbɛtumi agu ne ho fi. (Sɛ obi wɔ aso a ɔde bɛtie a, ɔntie!) Na ɔfirii nkurɔfokuo no nkyɛn baa fie no, n’asuafoɔ no bisaa no bɛ no ase. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo nso monni nteaseɛ sei? Monhunu sɛ adeɛ biara a ɛfiri onipa ho, na ɛkɔ ne mu no ntumi ngu ne ho fi anaa? Ɛfiri sɛ ɛnkɔ n’akomam, na mmom ɛkɔ ɔyafunu mu, na mmom ɔyi gu yaane mu. (Ɔkaa yei de tee aduane nyinaa ho). Na ɔkaa sɛ: Deɛ ɛfiri onipa mu ba no, ɛno na ɛgu onipa ho fi. Na nnipa mu, wɔn akoma mu, na adwemmɔne firi ba: Adwamansɛm, akorɔnsɛm, awudisɛm, ayerefasɛm, aniberebereɛ, amumuyɛ, nsisie, ahohwie, anibɔne, abususɛm, ahantan ne nkwaseasɛm. Nnebɔne yi nyinaa firi onipa mu na ɛba, na ɛgu onipa ho fi.


Na ɔsɔre firii hɔ kɔɔ Tiro ne Sidon fam. Na ɔkɔɔ efie bi mu, na wampɛ sɛ obiara teɛ; nso wantumi anhunta. Na amonom hɔ ara ɔbaa bi a ne babaa kumaa bi wɔ honhom fi tee ne nka no, ɔba bɛhwee ne nan ase; nso na ɔbaa no yɛ Helani, na n’awoɔ mu ɔyɛ Siro-Foinikeni; na ɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔntu honhommɔne no mfiri ne babaa no mu. Na Yesu see no sɛ: Ma mma mmee ansa; na ɛnyɛ fɛ sɛ wɔfa mma aduane to ma nkraman. Na ɔbaa no bua see no sɛ: Awurade, ɛwom saa deɛ; nanso nkraman a wɔwɔ ɛpono ase no nso di mmɔfra no mporoporowa no bi! Na Yesu see no sɛ: Asɛm yi nti, kɔ! Honhommɔne no afiri wo babaa no mu. Na ɔkɔɔ ne fie no, ɔkɔhunuu sɛ honhommɔne no afiri kɔ, na ne babaa no da mpa so.

Na ɔfiri Tiro ahyeɛ so nam Sidon baa Galilea po ho faa Dekapoli ahyeɛ so. Na wɔde ɔsotifoɔ a ɔworo dodoɔ brɛɛ no, na wɔsrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne nsa nto ne so. Na Yesu faa no firii nkurɔfokuo no mu kɔɔ nkyɛn de ne nsateaa hyehyɛɛ n’asom, na ɔtee ntasuo de kaa ne tɛkyerɛma, na ɔhwɛɛ soro guu ahome, na ɔsee no sɛ: Hefata! ɛne sɛ: Bue! Na n’aso buee, na ne tɛkyerɛma homa no sanee ntɛm ara, na ɔtumi kasaa yie. Na ɔbaraa wɔn sɛ wɔnnka nkyerɛ obiara; nanso ɔrekɔ so bara wɔn no, na wɔrekɔ so pae mu ka. Na ɛyɛɛ wɔn ahodwiri boroo so, na wɔkaa sɛ: Wayɛ nnoɔma nyinaa yie, ɔma asotifoɔ te asɛm, na ɔma emum kasa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
